nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There is a box speaker above the fire door. It used to carry the school bell. It is still switched on.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A whole class is talking on the other side of the wall. The voices run together, then stop all at once, as if someone has just come in.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: That is C's lot. They do that.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The speaker clicks twice and goes quiet.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A cleaning trolley is parked across the cupboard, wheels turned in.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A mop, half a bucket of water, and a bottle of yellow cleaning fluid. The cupboard behind them seems to be full of exercise books; you can make out the spines.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Leave the bucket. It has been there since Monday.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You leave the trolley alone. It blocks the cupboard, but there is room to get past it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You stop by the railing. The yard looks different from up here than it did through the classroom window. Even the colours seem to have changed.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Two hoops, a shed, a stretch of concrete. You watch for a while. Nothing much happens.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The lesson carries on without you. You don't mind as much as you thought you might.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You stood at the walkway railing during the free period and watched the yard.
